scope: Target-native scalp and owned groom integration on the selected CC0 rig foundation

skinBrightnessEvidence.conclusion: The r962-r977 branch does not reproduce the website v83 darkening. Global exposure remains unchanged.

r974.reason: Rigid landmark alignment leaves the smaller r584 scalp and cards inside the larger r962 cranium; visible ribbons appear detached above and beside the head.

r976.visualFinding: Target-native coverage, warm-brown response and center part are coherent, but the silhouette remains a uniform straight curtain with weak macro-locks and identical end lengths.

remainingVisualFailures: insufficient front, side and rear macro-lock hierarchy
r977.promotion: Do not replace website v83 or r962. Use only as the next target-native hair construction base.

nextRequiredWork: On r977, build coherent front/side/rear macro-lock families with staggered lengths and ear-tuck structure, then add head-bound dynamic chains with root pinning, damping, gravity and per-frame body collision limits before runtime export.
